entries.search: GCRMN finds a 9.5 per cent drop in global hard coral cover GCRMN released a new status report on Monday with the International Coral Reef Initiative. Comparing 2020-24 with 1980-2009, it finds a 9.5 per cent decline in global hard coral cover, and in Australia cover fell from 30.2 per cent to 26.8 per cent. Manuel Gonzalez Rivero says bleaching has roughly doubled in frequency, so reefs no longer get the recovery time they need. Reefs cover under 1 per cent of the ocean floor and support more than 25 per cent of marine life. science Science Science 2026-09-01 Hard coral cover fell 9.5 per cent from the GCRMN 1980-2009 reference Bleaching frequency, Manuel Gonzalez Rivero said, has roughly doubled Sharp declines hit Pilbara and the southern Great Barrier Reef Australian hard coral cover fell from 30.2 to 26.8 per cent against a 9.5 per cent global decline Phys.org Coral bleaching now returns twice as fast as reefs can recover Al Jazeera

entries.summary: Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan announced a permanent secretariat in Riyadh for their Mecca Joint Defence Agreement, stipulating that an armed attack on one is an attack on all. entries.search: Trump leaves the US line on Falklands sovereignty open Asked whether he was reconsidering US support for British sovereignty over the Falklands, Donald Trump said he reviews every position. Washington takes no official side and in practice recognises British administration. An unnamed official said that stance could change if Britain missed defence spending commitments. John Healey is preparing a 28 October budget to drop the 3 percent of GDP pledge by 2030. A Pentagon email in April tied a review to the Iran war. Scott Bessent opened the G20 seeking allied backing to sanction another Iranian bank. geopolitics Geopolitics Geopolitics 2026-09-01 Trump tells reporters the Falklands stance is one of many under review Healey prepares to drop the 3 percent defence pledge as a Pentagon email cites Iran Bessent opens the G20 seeking allied backing to sanction another Iranian bank Trump signals a review of the US stance on the Falklands The Guardian Bessent opens the G20 in Asheville seeking allied backing for more Iran sanctions AP News
entries.summary: Asked whether he was reconsidering US support for British sovereignty over the Falklands, Donald Trump said he reviews every position. Washington takes no official side and in practice recognises British administration. An unnamed official said that stance could change if Britain missed defence spending commitments. John Healey is preparing a 28 October budget to drop the 3 percent of GDP pledge by 2030. A Pentagon email in April tied a review to the Iran war. Scott Bessent opened the G20 seeking allied backing to sanction another Iranian bank.
entries.title: Trump leaves the US line on Falklands sovereignty open

entries.search: US financial regulators advance interagency coordination on compliance and disclosures The Commodity Futures Trading Commission and the Securities and Exchange Commission have extended the compliance date for the 2024 amendments to Form PF from October 2026 to July 2027. The delay prevents private fund advisers from incurring costs to comply with requirements that may soon be modified. In a separate interagency effort, the SEC and the FDA signed a three-year memorandum to streamline information sharing regarding company disclosures that impact markets. economics-markets Economics & Markets Economics 2026-09-01 Form PF compliance date moved to 1 July 2027 20 April 2026 rule proposal justified the Form PF delay Three-year FDA memorandum streamlines corporate-disclosure sharing The Form PF compliance date for hedge fund reporting was pushed to 1 July 2027 by the CFTC and SEC U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission The SEC and FDA signed a memorandum on sharing information about company disclosures U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission
entries.summary: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission and the Securities and Exchange Commission have extended the compliance date for the 2024 amendments to Form PF from October 2026 to July 2027. The delay prevents private fund advisers from incurring costs to comply with requirements that may soon be modified. In a separate interagency effort, the SEC and the FDA signed a three-year memorandum to streamline information sharing regarding company disclosures that impact markets.

entries.search: XENONnT catches solar boron 8 neutrinos and hits the fog they make The XENON collaboration reports a 3.3 sigma measurement of coherent elastic neutrino nucleus scattering from solar boron 8 neutrinos, gathered over 6.77 tonne years in liquid xenon under Gran Sasso. The inferred flux is 5 million neutrinos per square centimetre per second, from 3 million to 8 million, in line with earlier measurements. The detector was built to hunt dark matter; a neutrino bounce off a whole xenon nucleus leaves much the same trace a light dark matter particle would. science Science Science 2026-09-01 XENONnT catches solar boron 8 neutrinos at 3.3 sigma The neutrino trace walks into the fog of a light dark matter hunt Simulations place rocky planet building blocks 100 million years after the Big Bang XENONnT catches solar boron-8 neutrinos and runs into the fog they make Scientific American Simulations place rocky planet building blocks 100 million years after the Big Bang ScienceDaily
entries.summary: The XENON collaboration reports a 3.3 sigma measurement of coherent elastic neutrino nucleus scattering from solar boron 8 neutrinos, gathered over 6.77 tonne years in liquid xenon under Gran Sasso. The inferred flux is 5 million neutrinos per square centimetre per second, from 3 million to 8 million, in line with earlier measurements. The detector was built to hunt dark matter; a neutrino bounce off a whole xenon nucleus leaves much the same trace a light dark matter particle would.
entries.title: XENONnT catches solar boron 8 neutrinos and hits the fog they make
